title: Manyhands JSON v1 operation in the way
description: The operation whose unfinished row a request was refused for, and whose it is. operation_id, family, action and item_id are as operation show gives them; when the answer could not read the operation's row it names the operation by what its wait knew alone, operation_id, family and live true, and every other field is null; request_id, author, host, pid and started_at are its attribution, null for an operation recorded before operations were attributed: request_id is the request that began it, author the identity it committed as, host and pid the process that last held it, started_at when the request began it, in UTC. live is the judgment the answer was made on, never stored, with the meaning operation show gives it: true when it names this host and a process that exists there, or, naming no process of this host, when its indexing heartbeat is fresh; false otherwise; null when it names no host and no process. A row naming the reading process itself is judged by its heartbeat alone, since that process always exists, and one naming a process of this host that is gone is false whatever its heartbeat. A busy answer names a live operation: the request waited for it and may be sent again as it is. A recovery_required answer names one whose holder is gone.
